verdict.rationale: Account data portability is a fair question for a SaaS like Convertio, but the evidence shows no account-level export of user data (history, settings, stored files). Its format-conversion capability and its 24-hour file deletion are adjacent features, not a way to export everything you hold with the service and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
